text.Kredi notu, başvuru belgeleri, faiz oran: Frequently asked questions about credit scores, application documents, interest rates and the application process on KredimGeldi.
text.Aradığınız Cevabı Bulamadınız mı? Hemen: Can't Find the Answer You're Looking For? Ask Us Now!
text.1. Kredi notu nedir ve nasıl yükseltilir: 1. What is a credit score and how can I raise it?
text.Kredi notu, bankaların bireylerin kredi: A credit score is a scoring system banks use to assess an individual's credit risk, and it depends on factors such as payment history, amount of debt and credit usage. To raise your score, pay your debts on time, don't exceed your credit limits and be careful about applying for new loans.
text.2. İhtiyaç kredisi başvurusu için gerekl: 2. What documents do I need to apply for a personal loan?
text.İhtiyaç kredisi başvurusu için kimlik be: To apply for a personal loan, you need an ID document, proof of income (a payslip or tax certificate), and a proof of residence document or a recent utility bill. Banks may request additional documents, and your credit score is also important in the assessment process.
text.3. Konut kredisi faiz oranları nasıl bel: 3. How are home loan interest rates determined and what should I watch out for?
text.Konut kredisi faiz oranları, ekonomik ko: Home loan interest rates are determined by economic conditions, inflation and banks' policies. When applying, consider not just the interest rate but also the processing fee, insurance costs and other additional costs, and review the loan term and repayment plan carefully.
text.4. Taşıt kredisi ile ihtiyaç kredisi ara: 4. What are the differences between a vehicle loan and a personal loan?
text.Taşıt kredisi, yalnızca araç alımı için: A vehicle loan is a type of loan granted only for buying a vehicle, usually with the vehicle pledged as collateral, and its interest rates are generally lower than those of personal loans. A personal loan, on the other hand, can be used for any purpose and has more flexible terms, but its interest rates may be higher.
text.5. Kredi kartı başvurusu yaparken nelere: 5. What should I look out for when applying for a credit card?
text.Kredi kartı başvurusu yaparken faiz oran: When applying for a credit card, consider the interest rates, annual fee, installment and reward point benefits, additional services and campaigns. Also check whether your income and credit score are suitable, and avoid cards with excessively high limits.
text.6. Kredi başvurusu reddedilirse ne yapma: 6. What should I do if my loan application is rejected?
text.Kredi başvurusu reddedildiğinde öncelikl: If your loan application is rejected, first find out the reason for the rejection; if factors such as a low credit score or insufficient income are involved, work on improving them. Reduce your debts, make your loan payments regularly and apply again after a while.
text.Merak ettiğiniz her şey burada! Sıkça So: Everything you're curious about is here! Get all the details in our Frequently Asked Questions.
text.Kredinizle ilgili sorular mı var? Cevapl: Have questions about your loan? The answers are waiting for you in our FAQ section!
text.1. Teklifleri görmek için üye olmam gere: 1. Do I need to sign up to see offers?
text.Hayır. Kredi tutarını ve vadeyi seçtiğin: No. Once you choose the loan amount and term, you can see the banks' offers without signing up. Signing up lets you save your information and track your applications.
text.Başvurunuz önce alınır ve ilgili bankanı: Your application is first received and then forwarded to the relevant bank for assessment. If you applied as a member, you can track every step under My Account > My Applications and, once it's finalized, see the approved amount and installment.
text.3. Sitede gördüğüm taksit kesin mi?: 3. Is the installment I see on the site final?
text.Gösterilen taksitler, bankaların güncel: The installments shown are estimated amounts calculated with the banks' current rates, including KKDF (Resource Utilization Support Fund) and BSMV (Banking and Insurance Transaction Tax). The final rate and installment are determined after the bank assesses your income and credit history.
text.Bilgileriniz şifreli bağlantıyla iletili: Your information is transmitted over an encrypted connection and used only to assess your application. For details, see our Personal Data Protection and Privacy Notice pages.
text.5. Üye olmadan başvuru yapabilir miyim?: 5. Can I apply without signing up?
text.Evet. Kimlik bilgilerinizi girerek üye o: Yes. You can also apply without signing up by entering your identity details; you'll be given an application number. If you sign up, your information is saved, you won't need to re-enter it for future applications, and you can track your applications step by step.
text.6. Birden fazla bankaya başvurmak kredi: 6. Does applying to multiple banks affect my credit score?
text.Kısa sürede çok sayıda kredi başvurusu y: Making many loan applications in a short period can hurt your credit score. That's why we recommend first comparing offers and then applying to the one or two banks that suit you best.
